content.title: What Are We Really Asking For?
content.subtitle: Is What We Ask for Truly Beneficial for Us?
content.body:
Every day, we are running. To know more, live better, and become better people. With this desire, something new is constantly being added to our lives. But have we ever stopped to think: is everything we are gaining truly beneficial for us?

Our Knowledge Is Increasing, But Is It Beneficial?

Today, we have countless opportunities to learn through books, courses, videos, and many other sources. But is all the knowledge we gain truly beneficial? The knowledge that helps us move forward in this world, does it also benefit our Akhirah?

Our Rizq Is Increasing, But Does It Have Barakah?

We all want better Rizq, a good job, business success, higher income, and financial stability. But while seeking more, have we ever thought about its purity? Is the income we work day and night for Halal and pure?

We Are Performing Deeds, But Are They Being Accepted?

We offer Salah, read the Quran, make Dua, give Sadaqah, and try to do good deeds. But have we ever stopped to think: are these deeds actually being accepted by Allah?

Three Requests, One Beautiful Dua

Beneficial knowledge, pure Rizq, and accepted deeds are beautifully combined in a Dua taught by the Messenger ﷺ:

اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلاً مُّتَقَبَّلاً

Meaning: O Allah! I ask You for beneficial knowledge, pure Rizq, and accepted deeds.

What a short Dua, yet how deeply these three requests connect with our lives.

  • Beneficial knowledge.

  • Pure Rizq.

  • Accepted deeds.

Every day, we make countless plans for our lives. What we will learn, where we will work, how much we will earn, and how we will make our lives better. But alongside these plans, we should also develop the habit of asking Allah for the right things..

Make Dua Easier in a Busy Life

Because of our busy lives, we often struggle to remember the Duas we need. Remembering which Dua to read, how to read it, and what it means is not always easy. This is where Muslims Day can be your daily companion.

The Dua section of Muslims Day helps you find essential Duas in one place, read them with their meanings, and build the habit of practicing them regularly.
